heroSubtitle: MIC India develops and manufactures discrete semiconductor devices for industrial, lighting, mobility, and power conversion markets, combining disciplined process control with customer-focused technical support.
overview: MIC India is positioned as a dependable semiconductor manufacturing partner delivering discrete power and optoelectronic devices for global OEM, EMS, and industrial supply chains. Our operating model emphasizes process capability, incoming quality discipline, and fast commercial responsiveness for programs where consistency matters.
companyOverview: With a growing portfolio spanning rectifier diodes, Schottky devices, bridge rectifiers, LEDs, and transistors, MIC India serves customers that value predictable electrical performance, efficient sourcing, and manufacturing accountability. The company approach is rooted in engineering practicality, detailed quality documentation, and customer relationships built around long-term supply continuity.
vision: To become the preferred Indian semiconductor manufacturing brand for high-reliability discrete devices serving industrial and global electronics programs.
mission: To deliver dependable semiconductor solutions through disciplined manufacturing, application-driven engineering support, and responsive customer partnership.

manufacturingExcellence: Our manufacturing model combines incoming wafer and component control, monitored assembly conditions, and standardized outgoing electrical verification to keep production stable across volume ramps.
Dedicated process reviews, line qualification practices, and defined escalation paths support customers operating under audit, compliance, and field reliability expectations.
By pairing disciplined manufacturing execution with practical customer communication, MIC India helps reduce friction between procurement, quality, and engineering stakeholders.
qualityPolicy: Quality at MIC India begins with prevention. We focus on process control, lot traceability, documented inspection, and structured root-cause analysis when variation appears.
We are committed to meeting agreed specifications, improving manufacturing capability, and supporting our customers with dependable communication throughout the supply relationship.
Continuous improvement is embedded into the organization through line reviews, data-backed corrective actions, and regular quality objective tracking.
